text: When I was a man, every woman would want me because I would just love and cherish them and tell them how beautiful and precious they were and kiss them on their foreheads, play with their hair, buy them gifts, take them to nice dinners, spoil them, worship them and make sure that every day that they knew that they were the most magical and beautiful creature in the world. This is why as men you should be very careful listening to dating advice from women. And before anyone gets offended, this is not an attack. It's just reality. Most women have no idea what it is like to be a man dating women. Just like I, as a man, don't pretend to know what it's like to be a woman dating men. That is why I mostly give advice to men, not to women. Now let's talk about what she actually said. She genuinely believes that if she were a man, every woman would want her simply because she would spoil them, worship them, buy gifts, take them to nice dinners, and make every day feel magical? That sounds nice, it sounds romantic, but it is completely delusional. Does she really think that a man who worships, spoils, and buys gifts for every woman he meets is going to be desirable? No, that man is not desirable. That man is needy, convenient, and easy to use. Because the guys who try to buy a woman's attention from the very beginning usually don't value themselves. Deep down, they think they themselves are not enough. And because they don't believe they are enough, they try to compensate it with gifts, money, and worship. And here's the uncomfortable truth. Women themselves don't respect or want men like that. A woman is not going to respect or love a man who doesn't respect or love himself. A materialistic woman might stay with him for a while, sure, because it benefits her. She gets gifts, attention, nice dinners, and all the bonuses. But the moment a better option appears, even she is gone. Because what she's attached to is the benefit, not the man. Now let's be very clear, so no one twist this. There is nothing wrong with gifts, nice dinners, or trips for the right woman. For a woman that you are dating, for a woman who has proven that she is with you because of you, that respects, loves, and cherishes you. But doing all of that to win an affection of a woman you barely know, that's a mistake. Respect for yourself is non-negotiable. If you yourself are not enough, no amount of gifts or worship will fix that. And one more thing. I seriously doubt that the woman in the video keeps the same standards for herself that she demands from men. I highly doubt she spoils, cherishes, and makes every single day magical for her men. And even if she once had a guy who did all of that for her, something tells me she didn't choose him and stay with him long term. So guys, remember this. When it comes to learning how to date women as a man, be very careful taking advice from women. And above all, never compromise on your self-respect. Because without self-respect, nothing else works.
